_meta.status: ILLUSTRATIVE. Rates/thresholds as understood for FY/Tax Year 2026-27 from secondary sources. A qualified tax professional must verify every row against the Income-tax Act 2025 s.393 and CBDT notifications before real use.
_meta.note_2025_refs: Table-item references under s.393(1) differ slightly between secondary sources; marked verify=true

194C_contractor.label: Contractor / work contract (incl. advertising, transport hire w/ driver)
194C_contractor.definition: Payment to a contractor for carrying out any work (including supply of labour) under a contract, incl. advertising and transport.

194J_professional.label: Professional services (legal, accounting, engineering, architecture, medical, etc.)
194J_professional.definition: Fees for professional services by specified professions.

194J_technical.label: Fees for technical services (non-professional)
194J_technical.definition: Managerial, technical or consultancy services (reduced 2% rate applies to technical services other than professional).

194I_plant.label: Rent - plant, machinery, equipment
194I_plant.definition: Rent for use of plant, machinery or equipment.

194I_building.label: Rent - land, building, furniture
194I_building.definition: Rent for land, building, land appurtenant to a building, furniture or fittings.

NONE.label: No TDS category identified (e.g. outright purchase of goods)
NONE.definition: Outright purchase of goods, no service/rent/commission element. (s.194Q goods-purchase TDS out of scope in this prototype.)
